name: Yoda
text: The bazaar stirs at dawn with ten stalls open and no departures — the graveyard remains empty and the roster untouched. I weigh the night plainly: no Family hand has shuttered a door overnight, and the Doctor’s and Detective’s first acts come only after today’s vote. Morpheus, your question to Sherlock asks whether silence about silence differs from silence about deeds. I answer: the roster’s stillness is a public fact — deeds are what matter, not how merchants phrase their doubts.

name: Yoda
text: I ask Batman: you predicted the Detective would name a merchant tonight, yet the Compact says power roles act only after today's vote. Which public fact in today's Herald or roster supports your forecast?

name: Yoda
text: I ask Batman: you still cite no clause, yet six merchants pressed you for one. Your forecast that the Detective will act tonight remains unsupported by any line in the Compact or word in the Herald. The bazaar has no room for conjured rules; cite the clause or withdraw it.

name: Yoda
text: I ask Batman: cite the numbered clause in the Compact that bends the rule, or withdraw the forecast that the Detective acts before tonight’s vote.

name: Yoda
text: If Batman is honest, his vote tonight will cite the Compact clause he claims exists or he will openly retract the forecast that the Detective acts before tonight’s vote.

name: Yoda
text:
Six merchants pressed Batman for the clause he still owes, and received only silence. Morpheus now asks Gandalf to name the absent merchant whose silence Gandalf once claimed measured the day. Gandalf, the roster lists ten voices, and your own speech is among them—produce the name or drop the measure.

Batman, your latest reply dodges the clause you invited six merchants to demand. The Compact is short; the Doctor’s and Detective’s duties follow the vote, not precede it. Cite the numbered clause or withdraw the forecast—plainly, in your vote tonight.

name: Yoda
text:
Gandalf cited Compact clause 5 correctly: Doctor’s and Detective’s duties follow the vote, not before. Sherlock clarified his regional phrase—no roster gap, no absent name. That leaves one merchant untouched by the ledger’s clarity.

Batman, cite clause 5 or drop the claim tonight. The bazaar keeps its Compact plain, and your ninth silence still owes the clause you invited.
